Subject: Post-call: model mix & token volumes — pricing follow-up

Thanks for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can get you a tailored price/commit recommendation.

Recap (from our call):
- Use case: customer support automation + semantic search for knowledge base.
- Expected traffic pattern: steady transactional chat (customer messages -> chat completions) with spikes around product releases.
- Current MVP target: 1M monthly active users (MAU) in year 1; we estimated conversational events per MAU ~0.5/day.

Immediate asks to finalize pricing:
1) Confirm monthly token volume ranges per model type (ballpark is fine): chat (both prompt + completion tokens), embeddings, rerank. If you have per-message token averages, include them.
2) Budget range / target unit economics: target $/1M tokens or total monthly budget for Redwood inference.
3) Timing for a PoC and whether you want Hosted API or Dedicated capacity (we can show cost differences).

What I captured today (please correct):
- Model mix: chat 70%, embeddings 25%, rerank 5% of token-equivalent volume.
- Estimated token mix per event: chat = 900 tokens/event (avg), embeddings = 1 request = 0.5KB but we bill per embedding unit (we'll translate to token equivalent), rerank = small input + scoring.

Attached is a simple worksheet for token estimates (BrightLayer_token_estimates_20270420.xlsx) and our pricing summary (Redwood-pricing-summary-v2.pdf). If you can: fill in approximate monthly counts or confirm the model mix and target $/1M tokens and I'll return a tight price/commit recommendation and a 90-day PoC plan.

Next suggested steps:
- You: confirm volumes & target budget by Thu 4/22.
- Me: send modeled pricing scenarios (hosted vs dedicated) and a mutually actionable plan (MAP).

Thanks — happy to hop on a short follow-up if it’s easier to walk through the worksheet.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198

Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap and the attachments. Quick answers from our side based on estimates this morning:

- Confirmed MAU target: 1M (year 1). We expect ~0.5 conversations/day per active user for the MVP, scaling to 0.7 by year 2.
- Preliminary token averages (these are estimates):
  - Chat: ~850 avg tokens per conversation (prompt+completion).
  - Embeddings: ~1.2M embeddings/month to start (search + similarity for new content ingestion), average embedding size we expect to use is 1536-d (we can translate to units).
  - Rerank: ~150k requests/month (short inputs).
- Model preference: we want to use a high-quality chat model for customer-facing replies (priority on quality), a medium-cost embedding model for search, and a cheaper rerank model. Proposed split by workload (not strict): chat 65%, embeddings 30%, rerank 5% (by cost-importance).
- Budget: internal target is $3k–$8k / month during PoC, scaling to $25k–$50k/month in year 1 depending on adoption.

We can fill out the worksheet with a more precise count by EOD Thu 4/22. For PoC mode, we'd start Hosted for speed, but want to understand Dedicated TCO if we commit to year 1 volumes.

Thanks — will push our analytics folks to give a per-event token breakdown and upload the sheet.

Best,
Kate
Sr. Product Manager | BrightLayer
kate.miller@brightlayer.com

Kate — really helpful, thanks. A few clarifying points and our suggested next model/pricing assumptions so we can model scenarios:

Clarifications needed:
- For embeddings, when you say 1.2M embeddings/month, is that index-only (one embed per doc) or also query-time embeddings for reranking/search? If query-time embeddings are needed, please give an estimated queries/day.
- For rerank: are the 150k requests/month purely scoring calls or include pre-filtering steps?

Our suggested modeling assumptions (we'll include variations):
- Model tiers:
  - Chat (high-quality): redwood-chat-v1 (higher latency/cost, best coherency).
  - Embeddings (mid): redwood-embed-2048 (balanced quality/cost).
  - Rerank (low-cost): redwood-rank-lite (optimized for scoring).
- Proposed per-model volume split (tokens or equivalent) to model three scenarios (conservative / expected / aggressive):
  - Conservative: chat 55%, embeddings 40%, rerank 5%
  - Expected: chat 65%, embeddings 30%, rerank 5% (matches your call note)
  - Aggressive: chat 75%, embeddings 20%, rerank 5%
- Target unit economics to model: $/1M tokens tie-breaker buckets at $15, $50, $120 per 1M tokens (hosted) depending on model/commit. For dedicated, we'll show effective $/1M after commit discounts.

Next steps (I’ll do these):
1) I’ll model three pricing scenarios (hosted vs dedicated) using the embedding/request numbers you provided and the three model-mix splits above.
2) Send back a short MAP with recommended commit level, expected monthly $/1M tokens, estimated latency percentiles, and a 90-day PoC plan.
3) If the budget band you provided ($3k–$8k PoC) is correct, I’ll include a minimal-hosted PoC plan and a committed Dedicated option for comparison.

Can you confirm the embeddings details and whether PoC must be hosted-only? If yes, I’ll focus the first pass on hosted pricing.

Thanks again — expect the modeled scenarios by EOD Thu 4/22.

Best,
Marissa
